gaia.position_semantics: Gaia angular positions propagated to each acquisition; no observer parallax/perspective acceleration.
limitations: Catalog overlays are context, not measured SPHEREx source positions or confirmed cross-identifications.

Gaia search padding assumes total proper motion at most 12 arcsec/year; capped queries can omit sources.
WISE magnitudes are Vega-system profile fits; W1/W2 mean MJDs describe photometric sampling, not exact source-position reference epochs.

associations.method: Angular proximity after propagating Gaia to the WISE W1 mean MJD. That MJD approximates the positional epoch; observer parallax is not included.
limitations: Many-to-many candidates are retained. Proximity is not proof of identity.
Extended, blended, artifact-flagged sources and missing motions require review.
Only retained sources visible in a SPHEREx frame are compared; this is not a complete catalog cross-match.

catalog_context.interpretation: Imported catalog locators and proximity candidates; not measured SPHEREx positions or confirmed identities.
